# Code of conduct

steamcards follows the
[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
In short: be kind, be constructive, and assume good faith. Harassment,
personal attacks and discrimination aren't welcome anywhere in the project:
issues, pull requests, discussions or reviews.

If someone's behaviour is a problem, tell the maintainer,
[@joshgallantt](https://github.com/joshgallantt), privately. Reports are kept
confidential, and the Covenant's
[enforcement guidelines](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/#enforcement-guidelines)
decide what happens next.
